analysis.cache_max_bytes.doc: Disk space for the spectrograms and waveforms of analyzed files. The least recently viewed are removed first.

analysis.extensions.doc: File extensions, without the dot, of the files offered for analysis. Analyzing a folder includes only these.

analysis.max_full_minutes.doc: Maximum length, in minutes, of a file analyzed in full. Longer files are sampled.

analysis.on_download.doc: Analyzes each finished download whose extension is listed in Extensions.

analysis.sampled_windows.doc: Number of evenly spaced one-second stretches analyzed in a sampled file.

analysis.spectrogram.scale.doc: Frequency scale of the spectrogram: `log`, `linear` or `mel`. A scale picked in the browser overrides it.

analysis.timeout.doc: Maximum analysis time per file. A longer one stops and keeps its partial results.

analysis.upload_cache_max_bytes.doc: Disk space for files uploaded from the browser for analysis. The oldest are removed first, but the two newest are always kept.

analysis.upload_max_bytes.doc: Largest file that can be uploaded from the browser for analysis.

analysis.workers.doc: Number of files analyzed at once: `auto` for half the processors, or a number up to the processor count.

blacklist.enabled.doc: Refuses users at the addresses in the blocklist file.

blacklist.file.doc: Blocklist file in CIDR, P2P or DAT format, read again when a blocklist setting changes. Listed users also have their private messages dropped and room messages hidden, once their address is known.

blocking.default_scopes.doc: What a new block covers unless it says otherwise. Any of `uploads`, `searches`, `browse`, `messages`, `rooms`, `downloads` and `distributed`.

blocking.refusal_message.doc: What a user blocked from uploads is told when they try to download from you.

chat.accept_private_room_invitations.doc: Lets other users add you to their private rooms.

chat.auto_away.doc: Time with the web UI closed before you are shown as away. `0` turns this off.

chat.auto_reply.doc: Sent while you are away, as an automatic reply to each user's first private message.

chat.highlight_words.doc: Words and phrases that mark a room message as a mention. Matched as whole words, in any case.

chat.max_message_length.doc: Maximum length of a sent message, in characters.

chat.notifications.mentions.doc: How a room message that mentions you is announced.

chat.notifications.only_when_hidden.doc: No notifications while the tab is in view, except for messages in a chat that is not open.

chat.notifications.private_messages.doc: How a private message is announced.

chat.notifications.room_messages.doc: How messages in rooms set to notify of every message are announced.

debug.doc: Logs at debug level, with the module name on every line.

directories.downloads.doc: Directory for finished downloads. Defaults to `downloads` in the data directory. A directory set here must exist and be writable.

directories.incomplete.doc: Directory for downloads in progress. Defaults to `incomplete` in the data directory. A directory set here must exist and be writable.

feature.swagger.doc: Serves the OpenAPI document at `/swagger/v0/swagger.json` and the API browser at `/swagger`.

filters.search.request.doc: Regular expressions. Incoming searches that match any of them are not answered.

flags.config_watch_poll.doc: Checks the configuration files for changes every few seconds, for file systems that don't report changes.

flags.force_migrations.doc: Has no effect, and is accepted for compatibility.

flags.force_share_scan.doc: Runs a full share scan at startup, even when the share index is up to date.

flags.legacy_windows_tcp_keepalive.doc: Has no effect, and is accepted for compatibility.

flags.log_sql.doc: Logs every SQL statement with its values. The log then contains usernames, filenames and messages.

flags.no_config_watch.doc: Disables watching the configuration files. Changes then require a reload signal or a restart.

flags.no_connect.doc: Does not connect to the Soulseek server at startup.

flags.no_share_scan.doc: Skips the share scan at startup.

flags.no_start.doc: Starts up and exits without serving, to check a configuration.

flags.no_version_check.doc: Disables the check for a newer release.

flags.optimistic_relay_file_info.doc: Trusts a relay agent's share list for whether a file exists, instead of asking the agent first.

flags.volatile.doc: Keeps every database in memory. Nothing is saved across restarts.

headless.doc: Serves the API only, without the web UI.

instance_name.doc: Name of this instance in logs.

integrations.scripts.doc: Programs run when events happen, by name.

entries.doc: Names of the events that run the script. `Any`, `All` or `*` matches every event.
Command line run by the system shell.
Program started directly, with `args` or `arglist`.
Program arguments as one string, quoted by the user.
Program arguments as a list, each passed unchanged. Safer than `args`, where quoting determines where each argument ends.
Maximum run time before the script is stopped. `0` for no limit.

logger.loki.doc: Base URL of a Grafana Loki instance to push logs to.

logger.no_color.doc: Disables color in the console log. Setting `NO_COLOR` to any non-empty value has the same effect.

logging.level.doc: Minimum severity logged: `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` or `trace`. Debug mode lowers it to `debug`.

logging.targets.doc: Log levels for individual modules, such as `soulseek_client::distributed=trace`.

notifications.buddies.presence.doc: How a buddy coming online, going away or going offline is announced, for buddies set to notify.

notifications.jobs.analysis.doc: How the end of an analysis job is announced.

notifications.jobs.maintenance.doc: How the end of a cleanup or a database vacuum is announced. A failure is always shown.

notifications.jobs.scans.doc: How the end of a share scan is announced.

notifications.search.wishlist.doc: How new files found by a wishlist search are announced.

notifications.transfers.job_finished.doc: How finished downloads are announced, once per file, folder or album queued together.

notifications.transfers.upload_queued.doc: How an upload queued by another user is announced.

paths.cache.doc: Holds data that can be rebuilt, such as the share index.

paths.config.doc: Holds the configuration files and scripts. Can only be set from the environment or the command line.

paths.data.doc: Holds the databases and the settings applied at runtime.

relay.agents.doc: Agents allowed to connect to this controller, by name.

entries.doc: Instance name of the agent.
Secret the agent presents.
Networks the agent may connect from, comma-separated.

relay.controller_timeouts.file_ack.doc: Time an agent has to confirm it is sending a file a user downloads.

relay.controller_timeouts.file_info.doc: Time an agent has to report whether a requested file exists and its size.

relay.controller_timeouts.file_stream.doc: Time an agent has to start sending a file's data once it has confirmed.

relay.controller_timeouts.sync_deferral.doc: Time an agent may take after connecting to send its shares while it scans them. Past it, the agent is disconnected and reconnects.

relay.enabled.doc: Lets relay agents connect and share files through this daemon.

relay.limits.share_database_max.doc: Largest share database an agent may upload.

relay.mode.doc: Relay role: `controller`, the one the daemon plays. The relay agent is the separate `reseek-agent` program.

remote_configuration.doc: Lets administrators change settings from the web UI and the API.

remote_file_management.doc: Allows deleting files in the download directories from the web UI and the API.

retention.events.doc: Age after which logged events are deleted. `0` keeps them.

retention.events_max_rows.doc: Maximum number of events kept, deleting the oldest first. `0` for no limit.

retention.files.complete.doc: Age after which files in the downloads directory are deleted, by when they were last written. They are checked at each cleanup. Minimum: 30 minutes.

retention.files.incomplete.doc: Age after which files in the incomplete directory are deleted, by when they were last written. They are checked at each cleanup. Minimum: 30 minutes.

retention.jobs.age.doc: Age after which an ended job is deleted. `0` for no limit.

retention.jobs.count.doc: Maximum number of ended jobs kept, deleting the oldest first. `0` for no limit.

retention.logs.doc: Age after which daily log files are deleted. Minimum: 2 days.

retention.messages.max_per_conversation.doc: Maximum number of read private messages kept per conversation. Minimum: 250, or `0` for no limit.

retention.messages.max_per_room.doc: Maximum number of messages kept per room. Minimum: 250, or `0` for no limit.

retention.messages.mentions.doc: Age after which room messages that mention this account are deleted. `0` for no limit.

retention.messages.private.doc: Age after which read private messages are deleted. `0` for no limit.

retention.messages.rooms.doc: Age after which room messages are deleted, except those that mention this account. Minimum: 1 hour, or `0` for no limit.

retention.search.doc: Age after which finished searches are deleted. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.download.canceled.doc: Age after which canceled transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.download.errored.doc: Age after which transfers that errored, timed out or were rejected are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.download.failed.doc: Age after which errored or canceled transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.download.succeeded.doc: Age after which succeeded transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.purge_removed_after.doc: Time after a transfer is removed from the lists before it is deleted for good. When not set, removed transfers stay in the history. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.upload.canceled.doc: Age after which canceled transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.upload.errored.doc: Age after which transfers that errored, timed out or were rejected are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.upload.failed.doc: Age after which errored or canceled transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.transfers.upload.succeeded.doc: Age after which succeeded transfers are removed. Minimum: 5 minutes.

retention.users.doc: Time a user can go unseen before they are removed from Users. Buddies and users with a note, tag, block or group are kept.

rooms.doc: Chat rooms to join after login. Removing a room from the list does not leave it.

schedules.cleanup.doc: How often old data is deleted, as set in Retention. Minimum: 1 minute.

schedules.release_check.doc: How often reseek checks for a newer release. Minimum: 1 hour.

schedules.vacuum.doc: How often the databases are compacted to give back unused disk space.

search.filter_presets.doc: Named filters offered on the search page, such as `type:flac`. This list replaces the built-in presets.

entries.doc: Name shown in the presets menu.
Filter string placed in the filter box.

shares.buddies_only.doc: Aliases of shares only buddies and trusted buddies see, ignoring case. This covers relay agents' shares too. A buddy on your own network is not recognized as one.

shares.cache.retention.doc: How often the shares are rescanned: `off`, an interval such as `12h`, or days at a time of day such as `7d at 04:00`. Counted from the last finished scan. Minimum: 1 hour.

shares.cache.storage_mode.doc: Where the share index is kept: `memory`, loaded from a backup at each start, or `disk`, in the cache directory.

shares.cache.workers.doc: Number of files read at once during a scan. One per processor when not set.

shares.directories.doc: Shared directories, each an absolute path. A leading `[alias]` sets an alias, and a leading `!` excludes the directory instead.

shares.filters.doc: Regular expressions. Files whose full path matches any of them are not shared.

shares.follow_symlinks.doc: Follows symbolic links inside the shares. A shared directory that is itself a link is always followed.

shares.trusted_only.doc: Aliases of shares only trusted buddies see, ignoring case. This covers relay agents' shares too. A buddy on your own network is not recognized as one.

shutdown_timeout.doc: How long a shutdown waits for work in progress to finish.

soulseek.address.doc: Host name of the Soulseek server.

soulseek.browse.response_timeout.doc: Time a user has to start sending their file list when browsed. Minimum: 1 second.

soulseek.connection.buffer.read.doc: Read buffer size per connection, in bytes. Minimum: 1024.

soulseek.connection.buffer.transfer.doc: Buffer size per transfer connection, in bytes. Minimum: 81920. A change applies to transfers started after it.

soulseek.connection.buffer.write.doc: Write buffer size per connection, in bytes. Minimum: 1024.

soulseek.connection.buffer.write_queue.doc: Maximum number of pending writes per connection, from 5 to 5000.

soulseek.connection.mtu.doc: MTU of the server connection, from 576 to 65535. The system default applies when not set.

soulseek.connection.proxy.enabled.doc: Routes outgoing connections through the proxy.

soulseek.connection.timeout.connect.doc: Maximum time to open a connection. Minimum: 1 second.

soulseek.connection.timeout.inactivity.doc: Idle time after which a peer connection is closed. Minimum: 1 second.

soulseek.connection.timeout.transfer.doc: Time a transfer may stall before it fails. Minimum: 30 seconds.

soulseek.connection.timeout.transfer_res.doc: Time another user has to answer a transfer request, for uploads and for `transfer_request` downloads. Minimum: 1 second.

soulseek.description.doc: Profile text shown to other users.

soulseek.diagnostic_level.doc: Minimum severity of logged protocol diagnostics: `none`, `warning`, `info` or `debug`.

soulseek.distributed_network.child_limit.doc: Maximum number of users to pass searches on to in the distributed network.

soulseek.distributed_network.disable_chi.doc: Stops passing searches on to other users in the distributed network.

soulseek.distributed_network.disabled.doc: Turns off the distributed network, which passes searches between users.

soulseek.distributed_network.logging.doc: Logs details of the distributed network.

soulseek.limits.distributed_parent_negot.doc: Time a user offering to pass you searches in the distributed network has to start doing so. One that doesn't is dropped.

soulseek.limits.max_cached_peer_connecti.doc: Maximum number of message connections to other users kept open.

soulseek.limits.max_concurrent_peer_conn.doc: Maximum number of connections to other users being opened at once.

soulseek.limits.max_message_size.doc: Largest file list accepted from another user. Other messages have smaller limits of their own.

soulseek.limits.search_response_cache_si.doc: Maximum number of search results held for users who can't be reached yet.

soulseek.limits.user_endpoint_cache_size.doc: Maximum number of user addresses remembered between connections.

soulseek.listen_ip_address.doc: IP address on which to accept connections from other users.

soulseek.listen_port.doc: Port on which to accept connections from other users.

soulseek.picture.doc: Profile picture shown to other users. JPEG, GIF or BMP.

soulseek.port_mapping.doc: Opens the listen port on the router with UPnP, NAT-PMP or PCP while connected.

soulseek.search.max_concurrent.doc: Maximum number of outgoing searches run at once. Further searches wait. Minimum: 1.

soulseek.server_keepalive.enabled.doc: Sends TCP keep-alive probes on the server connection.

soulseek.server_keepalive.idle.doc: Idle time before the first probe. Minimum: 1 second.

soulseek.server_keepalive.probes.doc: Number of unanswered probes after which the connection is dropped. Minimum: 1.

throttling.search.incoming.circuit_break.doc: Maximum number of incoming searches waiting to be answered. Searches past it are dropped.

throttling.search.incoming.concurrency.doc: Number of incoming searches answered at once. Others wait in the search queue.

throttling.search.incoming.response_file.doc: Maximum number of files in one search response.

transfers.download.alt_speed_limit.doc: Total download speed limit in KiB/s while the alternative limits are on. No limit when not set.

transfers.download.destination.exists.doc: What happens when the file already exists: `rename` or `overwrite`.

transfers.download.destination.permissio.doc: File mode in octal chmod form, such as `644`. The system default applies when not set. Has no effect on Windows.

transfers.download.destination.subdirect.doc: Directory inside the downloads directory that finished files go to. `${SOURCE_USERNAME}`, `${SOURCE_PATH}`, `${SOURCE_DIRECTORY}`, `${JOB_ID}` (everything queued together), `${SEARCH_ID}` and `${SEARCH_TEXT}` are replaced with their values.

transfers.download.filters.doc: Regular expressions matched against each file's remote path, ignoring case. Matching files are skipped in folder and selection downloads, never when downloaded on their own.

transfers.download.request_style.doc: How a file is requested: `queue`, as every current client does, or `transfer_request`, the older style.

transfers.download.retry.attempts.doc: Number of attempts per download, including the first. `1` disables retries.

transfers.download.retry.delay.doc: Wait before the first retry. Each later wait doubles. Minimum: 1 second.

transfers.download.retry.max_delay.doc: Longest wait between retries. Minimum: 30 seconds.

transfers.download.retry.partial.doc: What a retry does with the part already downloaded: `resume` or `overwrite`.

transfers.download.slots.doc: Maximum number of downloads running at once. No limit when not set. Lowering it lets running downloads finish and starts no new one until fewer run.

transfers.download.speed_limit.doc: Total download speed limit in KiB/s. No limit when not set.

transfers.groups.blacklisted.cidrs.doc: Networks whose users are refused. Their private messages are also dropped and their room messages hidden, once their address is known.

transfers.groups.default.upload.priority.doc: Priority of the group. A lower number is served first.

transfers.groups.default.upload.slots.doc: Maximum number of uploads of the group running at once. Only the global limit applies when not set.

transfers.groups.default.upload.speed_li.doc: Total upload speed limit of the group in KiB/s. No limit when not set.

transfers.groups.default.upload.strategy.doc: How the group's queue is served: `roundrobin`, one file per user in turn, or `firstinfirstout`, in the order queued.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.priorit.doc: Priority of the group. A lower number is served first.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.slots.doc: Maximum number of uploads of the group running at once. Only the global limit applies when not set.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.speed_l.doc: Total upload speed limit of the group in KiB/s. No limit when not set.

transfers.groups.leechers.upload.strateg.doc: How the group's queue is served: `roundrobin`, one file per user in turn, or `firstinfirstout`, in the order queued.

entries.doc: Priority of the group. A lower number is served first.
How the group's queue is served: `roundrobin`, one file per user in turn, or `firstinfirstout`, in the order queued.
Maximum number of uploads of the group running at once. Only the global limit applies when not set.
Total upload speed limit of the group in KiB/s. No limit when not set.
Maximum number of files.
Maximum number of megabytes.
Maximum number of failed transfers.
Maximum number of files.
Maximum number of megabytes.
Maximum number of failed transfers.
Maximum number of files.
Maximum number of megabytes.
Maximum number of failed transfers.
Usernames in the group.

transfers.ui.queue_refresh.doc: How often the downloads page updates the queue position of the downloads on screen. Minimum: 30 seconds.

transfers.upload.alt_speed_limit.doc: Total upload speed limit in KiB/s while the alternative limits are on. No limit when not set.

transfers.upload.slots.doc: Maximum number of uploads running at once, across all groups. Lowering it lets running uploads finish and starts no new one until fewer run.

transfers.upload.speed_limit.doc: Total upload speed limit in KiB/s. No limit when not set.

users.cache_pictures.doc: Stores the profile pictures of other users.

web.authentication.api_key.doc: One API key as a single value: the key alone, with the administrator role from any network, or `;`-separated parts such as `role=readonly;cidr=192.168.1.0/24;<key>`.

entries.doc: API key, 16 to 255 characters.
Role of the key.
Networks the key may be used from, comma-separated.

web.authentication.disabled.doc: Turns off authentication, so every request has administrator access.

web.authentication.local.only_from.doc: Networks password login is allowed from. Any network when empty.

entries.doc: Password as an argon2id hash.
Password in plain text. Accepted with a warning at startup.
Role of the account.
Issuer URL of the provider.
Client ID registered with the provider.
Client secret, for a confidential client.
Label of the login button. The provider name is used when not set.
Requested scopes.
Claim that holds the groups of the user. A dotted path selects a nested claim.
Groups granted the administrator role.
Groups granted read and write access.
Groups granted read-only access.
Role for users in none of the groups, or `deny` to refuse them.
Subjects allowed to log in. Anyone when empty.
Verified email addresses allowed to log in. Anyone when empty.
Claim that holds the username. Falls back to the email address, then the subject.
Redirects the login page to this provider when it is the only one.
Lifetime of a session from this provider.
Redirects the browser to the logout page of the provider on logout, when the provider has one.
Accepts back-channel logout requests from the provider.
PEM file with an additional certificate authority, for a private provider.
Refuses an `http://` issuer that is not on this machine.

web.authentication.password_hash.doc: Administrator password as an argon2id hash. Used instead of `password` when set.

web.authentication.proxy.email_header.doc: Header that holds the email address.

web.authentication.proxy.enabled.doc: Accepts the user named by a trusted reverse proxy.

web.authentication.proxy.groups_header.doc: Header that holds the groups of the user, separated by `|` or `,`.

web.authentication.proxy.role_mapping.de.doc: Role for users in none of the groups, or `deny` to refuse them.

web.authentication.proxy.role_mapping.re.doc: Groups granted read and write access.

web.authentication.proxy.session.doc: Starts a session when the proxy names a user, so the web UI keeps working on requests without the proxy headers. When off, every request needs them.

web.authentication.session_idle.doc: Time after which an unused session expires.

web.authentication.session_ttl.doc: How long a password login lasts.

web.authentication.trusted_networks.doc: Networks whose requests need no credentials.

web.authentication.trusted_role.doc: Role granted to requests from trusted networks.

web.content_path.doc: Directory to serve the UI from, instead of the UI built into the program. Relative to the program directory.

web.cors.allowed_origins.doc: Origins, such as `http://localhost:5173`, that may call the API with credentials. `*` allows any origin without credentials. No other origin may call it when empty.

web.external_url.doc: Public base URL for login redirects, such as `https://reseek.example.net/reseek`. Derived from each request when not set.

web.files.archive_max_bytes.doc: Largest folder that may be downloaded as one zip archive.

web.files.serve.doc: Allows the browser to open and download files from the download directories.

web.files.serve_speed_limit.doc: Total speed limit for files and folders served to the browser, in KiB/s. No limit when not set.

web.hostnames.doc: Host names by which the daemon is reached. A trusted network is trusted only on these names, on IP addresses and on `localhost`.

web.https.certificate.cert.doc: PEM file with the certificate chain, used with `key`.

web.https.certificate.key.doc: PEM file with the private key for `cert`.

web.https.certificate.pfx.doc: PKCS#12 file with the certificate and its key, used when `cert` is not set.

web.https.force.doc: Redirects HTTP requests to HTTPS and sends HSTS.

web.https.ip_address.doc: Addresses to listen on, comma-separated. All addresses when not set.

web.ip_address.doc: Addresses to listen on, comma-separated. All IPv6 and IPv4 addresses when not set.

web.live.max_streams_per_principal.doc: Maximum number of live update streams one user or API key may hold open.

web.logging.doc: Logs one line per HTTP request.

web.port.doc: HTTP port. `0` picks a free port and writes it to the log.

web.socket.doc: Absolute path of an additional Unix domain socket to listen on.

web.trusted_proxies.doc: Networks of reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto` and `X-Forwarded-Host` headers are trusted.

web.url_base.doc: Path under which the daemon is served behind a reverse proxy, such as `/reseek`.
